title: Cloud Design
tagline: The microservices from my previous projects, designed and deployed on AWS with Terraform: containers, load balancing, auto scaling, monitoring and a private network for the data.
summary: The last project of the DevOps track. The six services built in CRUD Master, Play with Containers and Orchestrator (an API gateway, the inventory and billing apps, two PostgreSQL databases and RabbitMQ) are deployed on Amazon Web Services. The infrastructure is written as code with Terraform, the services run as Docker containers behind a load balancer and scale with the load, and the databases are reachable only from inside the VPC.
